stories.title: IndiGo flight aborts take-off in Mangaluru
stories.summary: An IndiGo flight to Bengaluru aborted its take-off at Mangaluru International Airport after sparks were spotted on the runway. All 236 people on board were safe. The aircraft was declared out of service for maintenance. A relief flight was arranged for the passengers.

stories.title: United Airlines resolves system outage
stories.summary: United Airlines resolved a technology issue that delayed hundreds of flights on Monday. The airline stated there was no indication of a cybersecurity incident. The disruption occurred days after a nationwide Federal Aviation Administration ground stop caused widespread delays across the United States.

stories.summary: United resolved a technology outage that delayed flights Monday and said there was no indication the issue was related to cybersecurity. stories.title: United Airlines says ‘widespread’ system outage resolved
stories.summary: United Airlines said on Monday that it had resolved a widespread system outage, just three days after the Federal Aviation Administration issued a rare nationwide ground stop on all US flights. “We have resolved a technology issue that delayed flight departures. While some flights were delayed, there was no impact

stories.title: United Airlines says it resolved system outage that delayed flights | CNN
stories.summary: A widespread, yet short-lived, system outage at United Airlines on Monday delayed some outbound flights at US airports, the airline told CNN in a statement, coming on the heels of a rare FAA ground stop that caused massive disruption. The outage lasted about 30 minutes, with fewer than 150 flights

stories.title: US flights returning to normal levels after weekend of disruption
stories.summary: Flights across the US are returning to normal following a technical failure that triggered a national ground stop. President Donald Trump attributed the disruption to very old equipment having a heart attack. When asked if he took responsibility for the event, the President said he did.

stories.title: Air India and Airbus partner for corporate SAF programme
stories.summary: Air India and Airbus have launched a feasibility study for a voluntary corporate Sustainable Aviation Fuel program to decarbonize Indian aviation. The initiative aims to foster a local ecosystem ahead of government mandates. India plans to require 1 percent SAF blending in jet fuel by 2027.

stories.title: Philippine Airlines signs contracts for 15 Boeing aircraft
stories.summary: Philippine Airlines has signed contracts with Boeing and GE Aerospace for 15 Boeing 787-10 Dreamliners, with purchase rights for five additional jets. The aircraft will be equipped with GEnx-1B engines. Deliveries are scheduled over the next decade. The airline did not disclose the value of the contracts.

stories.title: Boeing and Philippine Airlines finalize order for 20 Dreamliners
stories.summary: Boeing and Philippine Airlines have finalized an order for 15 787-10 Dreamliner aircraft, with an option for five more. The agreement follows a July 2026 commitment and is intended to support fleet modernization and capacity expansion. The 787-10 is the largest variant in the Dreamliner family.

stories.title: India prepares to order 1,000 more planes
stories.summary: Union minister Piyush Goyal said India is ready to order 1,000 more civilian aircraft to address an acute shortage. The country has already ordered 1,200 planes but requires over 2,000 to meet rising traffic demand. The government is currently pursuing established manufacturers for faster supply of the aircraft.

stories.title: India ready to order 1,000 more aircraft amid acute shortage
stories.summary: India is facing an acute shortage of civilian aircraft and is ready to order 1,000 more planes to meet air traffic demand, according to Union minister Piyush Goyal. The minister noted that the government is pursuing manufacturers for faster supply to support increased connectivity, including to Egypt.

stories.title: India ready to order 1,000 more planes amid aircraft shortage
stories.summary: Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal said India is ready to order 1,000 more civilian aircraft to meet rising demand. India has already placed orders for 1,200 planes but requires over 2,000 to meet its requirements. The government is currently in talks with established aircraft manufacturers.

stories.title: The Cathay Group orders 14 additional Airbus aircraft
stories.summary: The Cathay Group has placed a firm order for 14 additional Airbus aircraft, including 11 A330-900s and three A321neos. This brings the group's total firm commitment for the A330-900 to 41 aircraft. The new, fuel-efficient jets are intended to support regional and long-haul fleet modernization and expansion plans.

stories.title: PAL finalizes Boeing 787-10 order with GE Aerospace engines
stories.summary: Philippine Airlines has signed firm contracts for 15 Boeing 787-10 Dreamliners, with purchase rights for five more. The deal, which includes GEnx-1B engines, converts a commitment from July 2026 into a confirmed order. Deliveries are scheduled to begin in the next decade to renew the long-haul fleet.

stories.title: Air Canada places firm order for eight Airbus A350-1000 aircraft
stories.summary: Air Canada has confirmed a firm order for eight Airbus A350-1000 aircraft. The jets are expected to support long-haul operations with a range of up to 9,000 nautical miles. The order will enable non-stop services to the Indian subcontinent, Southeast Asia, and Australia as part of the airline's network strategy.

stories.title: Malaysia Airlines evaluates replacing its A350-900 fleet from 2030
stories.summary: Malaysia Airlines has launched a formal evaluation to replace its seven Airbus A350-900 aircraft starting in 2030. The airline typically keeps widebody jets for two decades, but the current fleet will be twelve years old by the replacement date. The carrier is currently selecting potential aircraft for the transition.

stories.title: Air India issues travel advisory amid US communication outage
stories.summary: Air India has issued a travel advisory regarding potential flight disruptions to and from the United States. The warning follows a nationwide ground stop caused by communication outages affecting air traffic operations. The airline has advised passengers to check their flight status on its official website.

stories.title: Duffy vows to modernize aging air traffic system
stories.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said he plans to modernize the US air traffic control system following a nationwide ground stop. Duffy stated he is deploying $12.5 billion in congressional funding for new radar and radio infrastructure. He noted that the required technology cannot be bought off the shelf.

stories.title: FAA turned down free Starlink offer, Elon Musk says
stories.summary: Elon Musk stated that the Federal Aviation Administration declined an offer for free Starlink terminals prior to last week's nationwide ground stop. Musk claimed the agency could have used the technology as a backup for air traffic communications. He cited the system failure as proof that it was needed.

stories.title: Duffy vows to modernize aging air traffic system
stories.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said he plans to build a modern, resilient telecommunications network for the US air traffic control system. He stated that he is currently deploying $12.5 billion in congressional funding for radar and radio upgrades. The secretary described the project as a necessary next phase.

stories.title: Former FAA executive says system was never compromised
stories.summary: Chris Metts, a former FAA executive, said the national air traffic system functioned as intended during the recent ground stop. Metts explained that the agency erred on the side of safety during the malfunction. He maintained that the safety of the National Airspace System was never compromised.

stories.title: HPE routers blamed for US flight ground stop
stories.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy clarified that HPE routers were not at fault for Friday's nationwide flight ground stop. Instead, the failure originated from older 2001 infrastructure that flooded the network during a switchover. The equipment functioned as intended, provided one ignores the resulting nationwide aviation paralysis.

stories.title: FAA begins five-day safety audit of India
stories.summary: The US Federal Aviation Administration has started a five-day review of India's aviation safety oversight framework. The assessment, running through November 20, evaluates the Directorate General of Civil Aviation's ability to maintain a Category 1 safety rating as the nation's aviation sector continues to expand rapidly.

stories.title: FAA conducts international safety assessment in India
stories.summary: The US Federal Aviation Administration has begun a five-day assessment of India's aviation safety regulator under its International Aviation Safety Assessment programme. The review evaluates whether the Directorate General of Civil Aviation possesses the necessary technical expertise and regulatory framework to ensure compliance with internationally recognised aviation safety standards.

stories.title: AELO Swiss Academy to attend Pilot Careers Live
stories.summary: Swiss Approved Training Organisation AELO Swiss Academy will attend Pilot Careers Live in Milan on November 21. The academy, established in 1985, intends to present its professional pilot training programs and engage with prospective students from Italy and other European markets during the recruitment event.

stories.title: Egnatia Aviation welcomes 19 new pilot cadets
stories.summary: Greek flight training organisation Egnatia Aviation has welcomed 19 new cadets from 12 countries into its Integrated ATPL programs. The cohort, known as Batch 102, will pursue professional pilot licensing under both European and UAE regulatory frameworks at the academy's Kavala training operation.

stories.title: Perkasa Flight School and NAAA announce training collaboration
stories.summary: Indonesian flight training organisation Perkasa Flight School has partnered with India's November Alpha Aviation Academy. The collaboration allows students from the Indian academy to complete professional pilot training in Indonesia, supporting Perkasa's ongoing efforts to recruit more international cadets to its DGCA-approved facilities.

stories.title: North Texas student pilot resumes training
stories.summary: A North Texas student pilot resumed flight training on Monday after his cross-country flight was interrupted by Friday's nationwide FAA ground stop. The student, who was nearing the end of his flight when the order was issued, returned to his airfield and reported feeling more confident.

stories.title: Texas student pilot takes flight again after nationwide FAA ground stop - CBS News
Airbus presents 20-year training market forecast
stories.summary: At the European Airline Training Symposium, Airbus Vice President Arnaud Demeusois presented a 20-year outlook for the global training market. The forecast draws on macroeconomic data, geopolitical dynamics, and traffic projections to predict how future training demand will evolve for the aviation industry.

stories.title: EASA discusses future of Multi-crew Pilot Licence
stories.summary: Ascanio Russo of EASA presented on the future of the Multi-crew Pilot Licence at the European Airline Training Symposium. The presentation questioned whether current instructors are sufficiently trained and whether existing regulatory requirements are adequate to support the future of ab initio pilot training.

stories.title: Regiment 915 prioritizes helicopter training quality
stories.summary: Regiment 915, based at Phan Thiet airport, has identified the improvement of helicopter pilot training as a key political task. The command focuses on scientific rigor across all stages of the process, from ground preparation to post-flight debriefing, to ensure effective coordination and problem-solving skills.

stories.title: Airline pilots face mandatory simulator testing
stories.summary: Under federal law, airline pilots must pass annual simulator testing to maintain their employment. These multi-million-dollar devices replicate cockpits and emergency scenarios, forcing pilots to demonstrate they can handle critical failures that would be too dangerous to practice in a real aircraft.

stories.title: Piper Aircraft eyes 100-plane deal with Alpha Aviation Group
stories.summary: Piper Aircraft is exploring a supply agreement with Alpha Aviation Group for more than 100 training aircraft. The potential deal follows an initial six-plane contract and aims to bolster Piper's presence in Southeast Asia while developing technical support capabilities in Brunei.
